player.subject: Did your session with {coach} take place?
player.text:
Hi {name},

Your {service} session with {coach} on {when} has ended.

Please confirm it took place, or report a problem, by {deadline}. Otherwise it is confirmed automatically and the payment is released to the coach.

Confirm or report: {url}

coach.subject: Confirm your session with {player} took place
coach.text:
Hi {name},

Your {service} session with {player} on {when} has ended.

Please confirm it took place — your confirmation counts as evidence if a problem is reported. The payout is released once {player} confirms or by {deadline}.

Confirm: {url}

player.text:
Hi {name},

{cancelledBy, select, player {You cancelled} other {{coach} cancelled}} the {service} session on {when}.

{amount} is refunded to you in full.

The attached update removes the session from your calendar. Book another time: {url}

coach.subject: {cancelledBy, select, coach {You cancelled your session with {player}} other {{player} cancelled the session}}
coach.text:
Hi {name},

{cancelledBy, select, coach {You cancelled} other {{player} cancelled}} the {service} session on {when}. The slot is open again and the player was refunded.

The attached update removes the session from your calendar.

verificationCode.subject: {code} is your PlayWithPro confirmation code
verificationCode.text:
Welcome to PlayWithPro! 🏓

Your confirmation code (valid for 15 minutes):

    {code}

Enter it on the screen where you signed up.

If you didn't create an account, you can ignore this email.

passwordReset.subject: Reset your PlayWithPro password
passwordReset.text:
We received a request to reset your PlayWithPro password.

Set a new password by opening the link below (valid for 1 hour):
{link}

If you didn't request this, you can ignore this email — your password stays unchanged.

approved.subject: You're verified on PlayWithPro 🎉
approved.text:
Hi {name},

Your professional profile has been verified. Players can now find and book you once availability opens.

See you at the table!

rejected.subject: Update on your PlayWithPro verification
rejected.text:
Hi {name},

We could not verify your professional profile this time.

Reviewer note: {note}

You can update your profile and submit again at any moment.
